mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a comfortable 63 degrees over Harriet Park, accompanied by a waning gibbous moon.
The city is preparing for road surface treatments from August 4 to August 7, and don't forget that you can apply for a 100 dollar rebate when you upgrade to a high efficiency toilet.

There is a lot to do this weekend, starting with the Remote Area Medical Clinic today at Verona Area High School and live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly look at local reports, on July 26, an 83 year old driver was cited for an improper left turn and a hit and run following a crash near West Verona Avenue.

Today is the perfect time to visit for the OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor of the day; the restaurant is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
